data.title: Albendazole
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Other antiparasitics_

**Class:** Benzimidazole anthelmintic (broad spectrum)

## Mechanism of action
- Binds parasite β-tubulin → inhibits microtubule polymerisation → impaired glucose uptake and energy depletion → death of worms (larvicidal, some ovicidal action)

## Pharmacokinetics
- Poorly absorbed; a fatty meal increases absorption (needed for tissue infections); active metabolite albendazole sulfoxide

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Cutaneous larva migrans (drug of choice with ivermectin): 400 mg daily for 3–7 days
- Cysticercosis (including cysticercosis cutis and neurocysticercosis — with steroids and anticonvulsants)
- Gnathostomiasis, larva currens (strongyloidiasis — ivermectin preferred), hookworm, ascariasis, hydatid disease
- Lymphatic filariasis mass drug administration (with DEC ± ivermectin)
- Deworming before starting long-term systemic steroids/immunosuppressants in endemic areas

## Dose & formulations
- Single dose 400 mg (worms; 200 mg in children 1–2 years)
- CLM: 400 mg daily × 3–7 days
- Neurocysticercosis: 15 mg/kg/day (max 800 mg) in 2 doses for 8–30 days, with steroids
- Gnathostomiasis: 400 mg twice daily for 21 days

## Adverse effects
- Single dose: GI upset, headache
- Long courses: raised transaminases, reversible alopecia, bone marrow suppression (rare)
- Neurocysticercosis: seizures/raised ICP from dying cysts (cover with steroids)

## Contraindications
- Pregnancy (first trimester) — teratogenic in animals; ocular cysticercosis (treat surgically first)

## Drug interactions
- Dexamethasone and praziquantel raise albendazole levels; carbamazepine/phenytoin lower them

## Monitoring
- CBC and LFT every 2 weeks on long courses

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid in the first trimester; single doses in 2nd/3rd trimester allowed in deworming programmes.

## Viva points
- Drug of choice for CLM (with ivermectin)
- Take with fatty food for tissue parasites
- Steroid cover in neurocysticercosis

_Sources: Khopkar ch.5 (Table 5.1); Wolverton 4e ch.12. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
